title: Data Lineage Coverage Gaps
dataSources: Catalog audit events (`collibra:audit`, `atlan:audit`, `datahub:audit`), OpenLineage run events (`openlineage:event`), Unity Catalog audit logs, Purview scan/classification results, stewardship and access-policy change events.
app: Collibra / Alation / Atlan / DataHub / Microsoft Purview / Databricks Unity Catalog audit logs and REST APIs via HEC scripted inputs; OpenLineage/Marquez events via HEC.
spl:
index=dataops sourcetype=openlineage:event
| stats dc(job_name) as producing_jobs by output_dataset
| append [ search index=dataops sourcetype=dbx:warehouse_freshness | stats count by table_name | rename table_name as output_dataset | eval producing_jobs=0 ]
| stats max(producing_jobs) as producing_jobs by output_dataset
| where producing_jobs=0
| sort output_dataset
description: Cross-references catalogued tables against observed lineage events to find datasets with no known producing job, i.e. lineage blind spots that undermine impact analysis.
value: Lineage gaps mean you cannot answer what breaks if this changes; finding untracked datasets improves governance and incident response.
implementation: Compare lineage outputs with the table inventory; schedule weekly; review gaps with data owners to instrument missing lineage.
visualization: Table of datasets lacking lineage, coverage trend.
grandmaExplanation: We find data tables whose origins are unknown, so you can always trace where your numbers come from.
